title: Subscriptions and resource groups
summary: An Azure subscription is a billing and management boundary. A resource group collects related resources for a project.
introduction: An Azure subscription is a billing and management boundary. A resource group collects related resources for a project. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An Azure subscription is a billing and management boundary. A resource group collects related resources for a project.

blocks.code:
Subscription: approved learning subscription
Resource group: rg-club-practice
Resources: storage and monitoring for the club project
blocks.title: Subscriptions and resource groups

blocks.text: The group gives related resources a shared management container. Resource-level settings still matter.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Name a group for a separate fictional project.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Deleting a resource group deletes its contained resources; never do that to an unknown group.
For more detail later, use this [Microsoft Azure further reading](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/ready/azure-setup-guide/).
